questions.stem: Explain the impact of high latency on streaming services and how it can be mitigated.
markingGuide: High latency causes delays in data transmission, leading to buffering.
Buffering disrupts the user experience by pausing playback.
Mitigation includes using content delivery networks (CDNs) to cache content closer to users.
Another solution is increasing buffer size to pre-load more content.
questions.explanation: High latency results in delayed data delivery, causing interruptions in streaming. CDNs and larger buffers help reduce the impact by ensuring smoother and faster content delivery.
